fields.Brand Customer Promise: Go native when you travel—stay at distinctive, independent-character hotels that reflect local culture and community while delivering the service excellence and loyalty benefits of the Choice network.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: One-of-a-kind stays rooted in local flavor, history, and design—not cookie-cutter hotel experiences.

Owners: Retain creative autonomy and independent character with Choice distribution, reservations, marketing, and Choice Privileges scale.

Choice: The industry’s pioneering soft brand (launched 2008) with a curated portfolio of boutique, historic, and unique hotels meeting defined membership standards.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Local authenticity — properties woven into community culture with art, amenities, and experiences that reflect the destination.

Independent spirit — each hotel keeps its distinctive character within a curated collection.

Soft-brand scale — global distribution and loyalty while preserving uniqueness.

Service excellence — membership criteria and commitment to guest satisfaction.
fields.Brand History: Launched in 2008 as the industry’s first soft brand, Ascend Hotel Collection has grown to 400+ hotels globally (2025), with refreshed brand identity honoring its pioneering legacy while emphasizing each property’s unique character.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Travelers who want to feel embedded in a destination—seeking hotels with story, local art, and community ties—and who value the reassurance of a major loyalty program and reservations backbone.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Pioneering soft-brand model combining independent hotel character with Choice scale.

Curated portfolio of historic, boutique, and unique properties with defined membership standards.

Marketing centered on authentic, local, “go native” travel experiences.

Continued growth and brand refresh (2025 logo and positioning evolution).
